name: Lamb
overview: The Bible presents the lamb as a significant symbol of sacrifice and provision, illustrated in God's provision of a lamb for Abraham's offering (Genesis 22:7-8) and the command for Israel to select a spotless lamb for the Passover (Exodus 12:3,5). The lamb also represents continual offerings to God, as shown by the daily sacrifice of two year-old lambs (Exodus 29:38). Additionally, the prohibition against boiling a young goat in its mother's milk (Exodus 23:19) underscores a divine principle related to the treatment of lambs and goats in worship and daily life.
